plugins.name: nexo-plugin-telegram
plugins.description: Telegram bot channel plugin — inbound messages + outbound replies via the Bot API.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-whatsapp
plugins.description: WhatsApp channel plugin — QR pairing + per-agent session multiplexing via wa-agent.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-email
plugins.description: Email channel plugin — IMAP intake + SMTP delivery with per-tenant account fan-out.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-google
plugins.description: Google OAuth + Gmail / Calendar / Drive tools as a subprocess plugin.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-web-search
plugins.description: Multi-provider web search tool — Brave, Tavily, DDG, Perplexity with per-binding policy.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-browser
plugins.description: Headless Chrome / CDP browser plugin — multi-instance per agent, auto-download of chrome-headless-shell.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-voice
plugins.description: Speech-to-text + text-to-speech tool plugin — Candle Whisper local inference + cloud providers.

plugins.name: nexo-plugin-admin
plugins.description: Official admin plugin — operator dashboard (agents, channels, plugins, memory, tenants) served out-of-tree.

plugins.name: nexo-poller-rss
plugins.description: RSS / Atom feed poller — scheduled tick fetches new items + dispatches to the agent loop.

plugins.name: nexo-poller-gmail
plugins.description: Gmail poller — scheduled inbox checks via the Gmail API with OAuth credential refresh.

plugins.name: nexo-poller-google-calendar
plugins.description: Google Calendar poller — scheduled event checks via the Calendar API with OAuth credential refresh.
